item.title: 【General Music Discussion】Next Female Discography to be posted
item.description:
Hey everyone! I've created this poll for you to vote on the next female discography I should post. My selection is based on the highest-selling female artists (source: https://chartmasters.org/46-best-selling-female-artists-50-million-album-sales/). If your favorite isn't on the list, please drop your suggestions below!

Check out these previous threads for an idea of what to expect:
Adele
Ava Max
Rosalía
Megan Thee Stallion
Dannii Minogue
Sophie Ellis-Bextor
P!nk
Enya
Aaliyah
Florence + The Machine
Rina Sawayama

I'll be re-uploading most of those when I find a reliable file host and have some free time.​

item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】WAV - L7 40th Anniversary with Lunachicks, CSS and Bonavega @ Los Angeles, CA 2025-10-03
item.description:
Raw waves at

Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.
Happy 40th Anniversary to the L7 setlist!

I just had to see Lunachicks, first time in CA since 2000 that I am aware of and CSS again. Loved them but not sure when / if this would ever get listened to again.

L7 when the first song kicked in it sounded like someone flipped a limiter switch. Suzy's vocals were never turned up when she was singing lead. And not much new in the setlist so it's the same show as always but not as good as I am used to. So just do whatever you want with the sound.

I got moved back at the end of the 1st Lunachicks song but other than people shoving themselves past in one direction or the other not much movement during L7.

Thanks to the person outside who gave me a ticket. Even though I rarely say what I am up to, it's people like you who make this possible. $75 and sold out the day of ... I can't do that over and over again.
item.author: ijwthstd
